title: Scalar-localization telescope with independent site universes
statement: Let C be a site with independent object and morphism universes, as in the independent-universe localization construction [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization], essentially small in the coefficient universe, and assume additive and commutative-ring sheafification with the usual local equivalence and ring-forgetful composition instances. Let R be a commutative ring sheaf, A a commutative ring, a:A -> Gamma(R), and t in A. Let S be the actual sheafified localization R[1/a(t)] with independent universes. Suppose F:Mod(R) -> Mod(S) is the sheafified tensor extension on both objects and maps and is additive and exact. Give both derived categories the constant-section actions specified by scalarLocalizationDerivedLinearOfUniverses [lem-per-rational-continuous-coefficient-derived-localization]. Then there is an additive, shift-compatible derived restriction functor U and an adjunction F.mapDerivedCategory left adjoint to U. For every bounded-below L the scalar telescope is a distinguished triangle whose cone identifies with U(F(L)), with n-th leg t^(-n) times the adjunction unit. The complete naturality and shift laws are exactly scalarLocalizationTelescopeProperty [lem-weil-pbc-scalar-localization-underlying-telescope]. Moreover F.mapDerivedCategory is semilinear over the canonical map A -> A[1/t]. This assertion contains no Hom-localization equivalence and no Hom-continuity condition.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2, Proposition 6.8.14(2), pp. 61--62; mapping-telescope construction, Stacks Tags 093W, 0949 and 015F.

proof.text: Use the normalized independent-universe tensor adjunction for the actual changeOfRingsOfUniverses model. Its right adjoint is exact restriction. Localize the termwise adjunction at quasi-isomorphisms using the canonical exact-functor factorization squares. The localization unit formula and cancellation of these squares prove the normalized derived-unit equation.

The independent-universe fraction-colimit theorem supplies the sequential complex colimit with its specified inverse-power legs. The coefficient-universe Grothendieck theorem supplies exact filtered colimits and countable coproducts. Apply the general complex-colimit homotopy-colimit theorem, and transport its cofan, successor, triangle and comparison along a complex representative isomorphism of each derived object. The normalized derived unit and scalar factorization identity give precisely each required leg.

The termwise ordinary adjunction unit commutes with shifts degreewise. Descend this equality using the unit-shift theorem; the telescope leg laws give naturality and shift compatibility. Restriction intertwines a scalar with its localized image by the localization lift formula. Adjunction injectivity gives semilinearity on scalar identities; the exact-derived factorization and essential surjectivity of Q give it on derived identities, and composition gives it on every derived morphism.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.8.2, Proposition 6.8.14(2), pp. 61--62; mapping-telescope construction, Stacks Tags 093W, 0949 and 015F. Independent-universe generalization of the proved small-site fraction-colimit chain and normalized tensor adjunction; generic derived telescope argument retained.

mathlib_searches.query: Sheafified scalar localization on a site is the mapping telescope of multiplication by the localized scalar, independent of object and morphism universe levels
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, on module sheafification scalar actions and sheafification localization. None gives the derived telescope with specified legs and shift laws.

from.place: Generic scalar-localization telescope in the Hom-comparison step; independent-universe adaptation for the actual pro-etale site.

theorem scalarLocalization_telescopeOfUniverses
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A] (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (a : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (R.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) (t : A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
        (ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses R (a t))))]
    (F : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
        (ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses R (a t))))
    (hF : ∀ M, F.obj M =
      SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsOfUniverses (ringedLocalizationRingUnitOfUniverses R (a t)) M)
    (_hmap : ∀ {M N} (f : M ⟶ N), F.map f = eqToHom (hF M) ≫
      SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHomOfUniverses
        (ringedLocalizationRingUnitOfUniverses R (a t)) M f ≫ eqToHom (hF N).symm)
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F] :
    letI := scalarLocalizationDerivedLinearOfUniverses A R a
    letI := scalarLocalizationDerivedLinearOfUniverses (Localization.Away t)
      (ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses R (a t))
      (scalarLocalizationCoefficientMapOfUniverses A R a t)
    ∃ (U : DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
          (ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses R (a t)))) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u}
          ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)))
      (_add : U.Additive) (_shift : U.CommShift ℤ) (adj : F.mapDerivedCategory ⊣ U),
      scalarLocalizationTelescopeProperty A t F.mapDerivedCategory U adj
        (fun L ↦ ∃ b : ℤ, L.IsGE b) ∧
      (∀ {K L} (f : K ⟶ L) (r : A),
        F.mapDerivedCategory.map (r • f) =
          algebraMap A (Localization.Away t) r • F.mapDerivedCategory.map f)
